blocks: RIBBON  34-pin header like a strip; own ground spade; 10R ground cancel to pin 26 (strip-like ground)
DUMMY CHANNELS  per bus, groups of 1 / 3 / 4 / 12 channels as one equivalent resistor (same noise and noise gain); slide switch at the bus end: on = bus, off = AGND (as the routing switches)
BUS CAPACITANCE  1 nF C0G per MIX / SUB 1 bus on a jumper: the 24 strips' DG413 switches + ribbon (~1.1 nF)
DUMMY WING LOAD  terminal for external power resistors (about 17 R / 20 W per rail = one 12-strip wing, 1 A)
